name: Tinted amber glass slab desk

reasons: Single three-quarter view; the back long face, the top slab underside and the inner faces of both panels below the brackets are not directly readable.
Subject is tinted transparent glass: albedo is inferred from transmission, so the material must be approximated with an amber-tinted transmissive/gloss shader.
The far (right) panel is nearly edge-on; its bracket pair and foot pads are mirrored from the near panel under the left-right symmetry assumption.
Macro silhouette (inverted-U of three flat slabs) is unambiguous and fills the frame, so the primary form is reconstructable.

materials.subtype: tinted float glass, amber body tint, flat-polished, ~15 mm
tinted float glass, same amber body tint, polished edges

mustMatch: Overall inverted-U of three flat slabs: top 1.40 m wide x 0.70 m deep x 0.015 m thick at 0.74 m total height, two end panels each 0.015 m thick.
Top slab overhangs each panel outer face by 0.050 m in width and each panel edge by 0.050 m front and back (panel depth 0.60 m against top depth 0.70 m).
Panel inner faces are 1.270 m apart; panel outer faces 1.300 m apart; no stretcher, apron or drawer anywhere between them.
Four bronze L-brackets, one at each top corner of each panel inner face, each with 0.16 m arms and a 0.04 m wide strap; the two brackets on a panel are 0.44 m apart centre to centre.
Glass thickness is uniform 0.015 m and visible as a distinct darker polished edge band on every slab edge.
Panel bottom edges stand 0.002 m clear of the floor on four glide pads, each about 0.03 m long, set 0.03 m in from the panel bottom corners.
niceToHave: Amber tint reads transmissive: far panel and its brackets faintly visible through the top slab.
Vertical tint gradient on panel faces from #C97A3A at top to #7E3F1C at the bottom edge.
Single broad untextured specular sheet reflection crossing the top face.
Bracket fixing bosses catch a small bronze highlight.
